claim: Apple's Q4 2023 net income was at least $19.5B.
summary: Apple's fiscal Q4 2023 (quarter ended Sep 30, 2023, reported Nov 2, 2023) net income was ~$22.96B, and calendar Q4 2023 (Apple fiscal Q1 2024) net income was ~$33.9B; both exceed the $19.5B threshold, so the 'at least $19.5B' claim is satisfied under either common interpretation of Q4 2023.
